headline: Nigerian Naira Extends Recovery to N1,376/$ as Interbank FX Turnover Falls
summary: The Nigerian naira extended its recovery against the US dollar, closing at N1,376/$ as interbank foreign exchange turnover dropped by 54.53% to $106.88 million.
why: Foreign exchange turnover and currency rates reflect liquidity conditions and supply-demand dynamics in emerging market foreign exchange sectors.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: The input reports the naira extended its recovery against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in interbank FX turnover alongside rising currency values indicates constrained dollar liquidity and shifting market clearing levels.
